o: There is a provision in the Constitution for the recognition of national and regional parties based on the number of states they contest in.
The Communist Party of India (Marxist) was established before India gained independence.
The symbol of the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) is an elephant, whereas the elephant is also a prominent symbol of the Republican Party in the United States.
Currently, India has more than 10 national political parties.
x: The BSP's symbol is the elephant, which is also the symbol of the US Republican Party. Recognition depends on poll performance under the Symbols Order, not the Constitution; the CPI(M) dates from 1964; India has six national parties.
